mediaQueries.reason: Settings theme previews remain readable at compact widths.
mediaQueries.migration: Re-evaluate against the shared mobile or command-center threshold when settings is restructured.
mediaQueries.review: Review when the settings preview layout changes.

mediaQueries.reason: The profile privacy control needs a narrower three-column layout than the shared mobile threshold.
mediaQueries.migration: Consolidate with the shared compact control breakpoint when the profile dialog is moved to container-query layout.
mediaQueries.review: Review when the profile privacy control changes.

mediaQueries.reason: The command-center action register becomes a single column before its labels truncate.
mediaQueries.migration: Keep local unless another shared compact surface adopts the same content-driven threshold.
mediaQueries.review: Review when the command-center composition changes.

mediaQueries.reason: Dense planner, Calendar header controls, and the ContentHeader fallback share an intermediate adjustment.
mediaQueries.migration: Replace the viewport fallback with container-query coverage when supported by the full browser matrix.
mediaQueries.review: Review when planner, Calendar controls, or header density changes.

mediaQueries.reason: Nutrition analysis preserves chart and label readability before the shared columns breakpoint.
mediaQueries.migration: Retain until nutrition charts adopt a tested container-driven layout.

mediaQueries.reason: Work detail actions need a feature-specific intermediate collapse.
mediaQueries.migration: Consolidate with a shared toolbar container rule when the Work action layout is migrated.
mediaQueries.review: Review when Work detail actions change.

mediaQueries.reason: The upper bound of the intermediate nutrition chart layout is content-driven.
mediaQueries.migration: Remove together with the 1120px nutrition interval after container-query adoption.

inlineStyles.reason: Only dynamic calendar data colors, state transforms, and portal/popup geometry may remain inline.
inlineStyles.migration: Move repeated positioning contracts behind shared popover/calendar primitives and convert static presentation to classes; preserve data-driven CSS variables.
inlineStyles.review: Review when calendar or task popup positioning changes.

inlineStyles.reason: Goal progress and user-selected accent colors are dynamic data passed through bounded CSS custom properties.
inlineStyles.migration: Keep only data-driven --goal-* properties; add no static presentation to these style objects.
inlineStyles.review: Review if the goal progress, detail, or accent-color data contract changes.

inlineStyles.reason: Report bars and taxonomy swatches use data-derived height and color values.
inlineStyles.migration: Prefer bounded CSS custom properties for report geometry and color while keeping all static presentation in classes.
inlineStyles.review: Review when the task-summary visualization contract changes.

inlineStyles.reason: These progress fills receive a data-derived scale transform; all track presentation remains in CSS.
inlineStyles.migration: Adopt ProgressBar where the metric is a simple bounded value; keep domain-specific geometry local where semantics differ.
inlineStyles.review: Review whenever one of these progress indicators changes markup or scale semantics.

inlineStyles.reason: ProgressMorph calculates transform and its caller-owned bounded duration at runtime.
inlineStyles.migration: Keep the dynamic duration clamped to the documented motion contract and avoid additional inline presentation.
inlineStyles.review: Review if ProgressMorph gains another dynamic style property.

inlineStyles.reason: The browser view-transition name must be unique to runtime record identity.
inlineStyles.migration: Keep the sanitized runtime name as the only inline property.
inlineStyles.review: Review if the view-transition identity model changes.

inlineStyles.reason: Travel readiness and composition bars expose data-derived percentages.
inlineStyles.migration: Adopt ProgressBar for simple bounded values while retaining domain composition geometry where needed.
inlineStyles.review: Review when Travel metric visualizations change.

inlineStyles.reason: Nutrition progress fills use bounded runtime scale transforms and a data-driven over-target color.
inlineStyles.migration: Adopt ProgressBar when the domain metric can preserve its over-target semantics through the shared tone contract.
inlineStyles.review: Review when Nutrition metric bars change.

inlineStyles.reason: Work progress, hierarchy depth, and persisted company colors are data-derived.
inlineStyles.migration: Prefer bounded custom properties and versioned taxonomy color mapping; keep static visuals in work.css.
inlineStyles.review: Review when Work progress or company-color contracts change.

inlineStyles.reason: The remaining inline width is a runtime bounded percentage.
inlineStyles.migration: Adopt ProgressBar or a bounded CSS custom property when these surfaces are next migrated.
inlineStyles.review: Review when either metric implementation changes.

inlineStyles.reason: Task list, tag, and priority controls render persisted or selected taxonomy colors at runtime.
inlineStyles.migration: Persist semantic taxonomy IDs and route runtime colors through bounded custom properties when the task schema next changes.
inlineStyles.review: Review when task taxonomy or quick-entry color controls change.

inlineStyles.reason: Sport chart marks use runtime series colors and data-derived geometry.
inlineStyles.migration: Route series colors through the chart migration vocabulary when the shared chart contract is adopted.

inlineStyles.reason: Dragged workout opacity reflects transient drag state.
inlineStyles.migration: Move drag state to a data attribute when the planner interaction layer is revised.

inlineStyles.reason: Portal positioners calculate collision-aware viewport geometry and an optional semantic layer at runtime.
inlineStyles.migration: Retain only measured geometry; component presentation remains in ui.css.
inlineStyles.review: Review when the shared floating-positioning primitive changes.

inlineStyles.reason: Menu merges the documented caller style escape hatch with its optional semantic layer.
inlineStyles.migration: Narrow or remove the caller style escape hatch when all dynamic menu geometry uses a shared positioner.
inlineStyles.review: Review when Menu style or layer props change.

inlineStyles.reason: The documented modal width escape hatch accepts runtime numeric or CSS width values.
inlineStyles.migration: Prefer named modal sizes and retain maxWidth only for the documented full-page dialog exception.
inlineStyles.review: Review when Modal width props change.

inlineStyles.reason: Ambient stream items receive a runtime sequence index through a bounded custom property.
inlineStyles.migration: Keep the index as the only inline shell presentation value.

motion.reason: ProgressMorph accepts a dynamic duration prop as an explicit shared animation contract.
motion.migration: Keep the value data-driven; clamp it to the documented motion range if the public API expands.
motion.review: Review when MotionValues gains another consumer or duration role.

motion.reason: The disclosure panel delays visibility removal by zero seconds after its spatial transition so collapsed content is not exposed during the animation.
motion.migration: Keep the visibility delay tied to the shared disclosure transition contract; remove the exception if the panel is moved to a state-driven primitive.
motion.review: Review when the app-shell disclosure animation changes.
